newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end sharply up in heavy trading.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end sharply up in heavy trading.

text.p: Heavy trading mainly by retail investors drove share prices up across the board on Tuesday and pushed the Dhaka stock index 169.04 points or 6.85 percent higher to 2,633.51.
Turnover was 485.7 million taka. Of the 119 issues traded, 89 rose, 26 lost and four were unchanged.
Brokers said good corporate news and rumours drove the market higher.
One trader said the rally seemed set to continue until December when several company meetings were scheduled.
Apex Foods rose 1,693.27 taka to 19,207.98 and Shine Pukur Holdings gained 21.23 to 234.
